record.body:
## Problem

se-workflow requires adaptive-artifacts, but install is two separate marketplace adds with no declared dependency. Users can install se-workflow alone and hit missing-runtime failures. Each repo hosts a one-plugin marketplace.

## Approach

Shared marketplace hosted in the se-workflow repo (decisions: marketplace-topology, marketplace-host). List both plugins in `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` (se-workflow as `./`, adaptive-artifacts via github source). Declare `adaptive-artifacts` in se-workflow `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` `dependencies`. Update README Claude install to one marketplace add; keep Cursor as clone/sync + PATH. Do not merge repos or rename to agent-affidavit in this phase.

Session shape: **one sitting**. Executor: **inline** for every wave.

Human stops: plan review (this gate); confirm `claude plugin validate .` (and optional install dry-run) before merge; Landing merge + store commit on primary.

Collision notes: single inline chat owns `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`, and README Install. Do not edit `skills/`, `se_workflow/`, or adaptive-artifacts. Parallel workflow-loop worktrees must not touch those three paths.

## Exit criteria

1. Installing se-workflow through the se-workflow Claude marketplace also enables adaptive-artifacts (same-marketplace dependency) — verified by `claude plugin validate .` on the changed manifests plus a short install dry-run checklist recorded in the verify task notes.
2. README Install steps match the manifests (single marketplace add for Claude) — verified by grepping README against the marketplace/plugin names in `.claude-plugin/*.json`.
3. Cursor install path remains documented without claiming Claude-only dependency auto-install — verified by README review (no false auto-dep claim).

## Landing

- Branch: `phase/plugin-dep-marketplace`
- Worktree: `/home/andrewyin/se-workflow--plugin-dep-marketplace`
- Base: `main`
- Close: commit code on the phase branch; merge that branch into `main`; commit the store on the primary checkout (`/home/andrewyin/se-workflow`).
